user.title: Home NILM
user.description: Choose the meter and the loads you already measure.

data.name: Name
data.variable_entities: Variable loads: entities that tell when they run (optional)

data_description.grid_power: Power exchanged with the grid (positive = import). With solar, the house load is grid + solar.
data_description.submeters: Loads you already measure (smart plugs, clamps). They are subtracted before disaggregation.
data_description.power_factor: Used to compute reactive power, which separates motors (fridges, pumps) from heaters. Values in % are accepted.
data_description.reactive_power: Use instead of the power factor if your meter reports reactive power directly.
data_description.variable_entities: For example air conditioners or heat pumps: while one is active, unexplained power goes to this category and is not asked about.

data.hour_weight: Weight of the hour of day

data_description.persistence_s: Steps shorter than this are ignored (start-up spikes, sensor misalignment).
data_description.hour_weight: 0 = ignore when appliances are usually used, 1 = strong preference.

error.grid_in_submeters: The grid sensor cannot also be a sub-meter.
error.pf_and_reactive: Choose either power factor or reactive power, not both.
